training_guidance: This index page maps document structure: TAB sheets cover manufacturing details like threading grooves, bearing seats, circlip grooves, splines, keyways, and threads.
Family codes (66300-A through 66600) organize component types: pinion shafts, solar shafts, hollow shafts, planetary components, gears, and ring nuts.
Use this index to locate specific geometric features and standards for shaft design, spline interfaces, bearing mounting, and gear component families in subsequent pages.
Each TAB reference corresponds to detailed technical sheets with tolerances, dimensions, and manufacturing rules for NX modeling.
summary: Page 7 is a comprehensive table of contents and index for the Bonfiglioli Technical Quality Handbook (MTQ-001). It lists TAB sheets covering specific manufacturing features (threading grooves, bearing seats, circlip grooves, splines, keyways, threads) and Family codes organizing component types (shafts, gears, planetary elements, ring nuts). This index serves as a navigation guide to detailed technical standards in subsequent pages.
